pd25.description: Frozen 25-source public-domain normal-scan candidate and its exact allow-list.

corpus.name: lieder-pd212-v8
corpus.description: The rights-cleared Lieder corpus: 3,867 windows from the 212 IMSLP sources the owner cleared on 2026-09-24. This is the DERIVED corpus, ready to train on. It is not the source snapshot under `sources` above, which holds all 215 sources including the three that are not cleared for redistribution.

rights.basis: Every included source's IMSLP record states Copyright: Public Domain.

excluded.IMSLP16883: no IMSLP record for the file id
excluded.IMSLP16400: no IMSLP record for the file id

rights.not_legal_advice: A provenance decision by the corpus owner. IMSLP notes public-domain treatment can be jurisdiction- and edition-specific.

notes.two_artifacts: `sources` locks the PRIVATE 215-source snapshot, used to rebuild the corpus from scratch; it contains sources not cleared for redistribution. `corpus` is the PUBLIC rights-cleared build. Fetch `corpus` to train; fetch `sources` only to rebuild or audit.
notes.shards_are_prefixed: Under lieder-pd212-v8/ in a bucket shared with the PDMX corpus and the OSSQ snapshot. package_pdmx.py names shards train-NNNN/valid-NNNN for any corpus, so each needs its own prefix.
